races.paceDynamic: Garavogue and Babychino will likely contest the early lead, with Garavogue's prominent style suggesting he'll track any pace rather than force it. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Legendary Day, Laplander, Fond Farewell, All One Word, Saccary, Son Of Tyran) creates a bunched field that will rely on the pace-setters to provide a target, setting up a tactical finish where positioning will be crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Garavogue and Babychino settle into a manageable rhythm without early pressure
scenarios.body: The front pair get an easy lead and kick clear turning for home before the hold-up brigade can get organized. Garavogue's higher rating and prominent style prove decisive in a steadily-run race.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine enough to stretch the field but not collapse the leaders
scenarios.body: The pace sets up perfectly for the closers as Garavogue and Babychino weaken in the final furlong. Legendary Day and Laplander benefit from their patient tactics and superior finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Finish
scenarios.trigger: If both pace-setters go too slow and create a sprint finish from the last hurdle
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with the entire field still in contention at the final flight. All One Word and Fond Farewell benefit from being fresher than the usual pace-setters in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Garavogue and Babychino go off too fast and both fade badly
scenarios.body: The early leaders burn out before the turn for home, leaving the race to the patient hold-up horses. Saccary gets a perfect setup from his closing style while Son Of Tyran finds one last effort before his usual late fade.

watchPoints.text: Son Of Tyran has faded in his last four starts and may struggle to sustain any challenge if in contention
Babychino has never placed on similar going despite prominent style that should suit soft conditions
Garavogue gets tactical advantage as only confirmed pace-setter but hasn't won in recent soft ground efforts
All One Word has limited hurdles experience and unproven stamina at this trip despite good going record
Fond Farewell is the only horse with a recent win on similar going conditions in this field

races.paceDynamic: Solid Performer will dictate from the front with minimal early pressure, as Inishcorker and Limerick Star are the only other forward-running horses but both prefer prominent rather than leading positions. This creates a moderate, sustainable gallop that will suit the quartet of hold-up horses (Arcadian Star, Crackling Fire, Western George, Therhythmofthenite) who can all travel comfortably before unleashing finishing kicks over the final 3-4 furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Solid Performer gets an easy lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: The confirmed leader controls the tempo completely and has enough left to resist late challenges. Inishcorker and Limerick Star provide the main threats but lack the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Inishcorker and Limerick Star press Solid Performer early creating unsustainable fractions
scenarios.body: The front three go too fast and tire badly in the closing stages on testing ground. Hold-up horses with proven stamina reserves sweep past the weakening leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Perfect Timing Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate and hold-up horses get clear runs in the straight
scenarios.body: The race sets up ideally for closers with good turn of foot. Crackling Fire and Arcadian Star time their challenges perfectly while front runners still have enough left to fight back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants the lead early creating stop-start fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from 4f out when the pace finally lifts. Raw ability trumps tactics with the highest-rated horses coming to the fore regardless of running style.

watchPoints.text: Solid Performer must be tracked closely early - if given 3+ length lead approaching first hurdle, becomes very hard to peg back
Inishcorker has shown temperament issues when pressured for lead - any keen early behavior compromises finishing kick
Track where hold-up horses get their runs turning for home - tight finishes here often decided by clearest passage
Western George's poor soft ground record (0 from 2) makes him vulnerable if ground rides as testing as appears
Watch Limerick Star's jumping rhythm - all previous runs on heavy going may make hurdles come up quicker than expected

races.paceDynamic: Looking As You Are and No No Fizz are the only horses with prominent tendencies, likely to share early duties in what should be a steady tempo. With five hold-up horses behind them, the pace will be sustainable early before intensifying from the home turn as the hold-up brigade look to unleash finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Looking As You Are and No No Fizz establish uncontested control through halfway.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows them to dictate fractions and have enough left to resist late challenges. Looking As You Are's consistent soft ground form and No No Fizz's recent Uttoxeter win make them hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Decides
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate and the field bunches turning for home.
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with plenty of room to maneuver and the leaders vulnerable to sustained challenges. Crazierthandaisy and Mermaids Cave have the class edge with strong finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Looking As You Are and No No Fizz go too slow early then suddenly quicken.
scenarios.body: The field gets strung out with positioning crucial, favoring horses that can adapt tactically rather than pure hold-up types. Blue Marvel's tactical speed and Notnowlinda's versatility could exploit the confusion.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground and distance combination creates a true staying test.
scenarios.body: The race becomes about who can grind it out longest rather than finishing kick, suiting horses with proven stamina reserves. Rialannah's multiple 24f runs and Blue Marvel's heavy ground third give them the endurance edge.

watchPoints.text: Looking As You Are getting uncontested lead could prove decisive given her soft ground consistency
Crazierthandaisy needs the pace to be strong enough early to set up her finishing kick
Blue Marvel's jumping - any mistakes will compromise her chances from hold-up position
Mermaids Cave requires clear run in straight after impressive Uttoxeter victory last time
Race tempo through first mile will determine whether stamina or speed prevails in finish

races.paceDynamic: Caughtinyourtrance and Admiral Stewart will both want to lead, creating an early contest that should establish a solid gallop from the start. scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Caughtinyourtrance and Admiral Stewart go too hard early in testing conditions
scenarios.body: The leaders weaken significantly from the second-last, allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past. Walk On High and Bowenspark benefit most from their restrained tactics in the soft ground.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders compromise each other but maintain a workable pace
scenarios.body: Daytime Dreaming and As Legends Have It can track the pace without over-racing, positioning perfectly to strike. The prominent runners get first run on the weakening leaders while the hold-up horses have too much to do.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Admiral Stewart or Caughtinyourtrance gets an uncontested lead and controls the tempo
scenarios.body: The free-running leader can dictate fractions and kick clear when the pressure comes, holding off late challenges. Their stamina over this extended trip proves decisive in the testing conditions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Suits
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong throughout without early collapse
scenarios.body: The horses with proven stamina at this trip thrive, with form over similar distances becoming crucial. Caughtinyourtrance's consistent 24f form and Walk On High's staying power come to the fore.

races.paceDynamic: Goodwin stands alone as the confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead in this 11-runner handicap hurdle. With most rivals adopting prominent or hold-up styles, Goodwin can dictate terms and potentially steal a march if allowed soft fractions early. The lack of pace pressure could see the field bunched turning for home, setting up a cavalry charge finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Goodwin Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and Goodwin is allowed easy sectionals early
scenarios.body: Goodwin builds an unassailable lead while the field allows him too much rope, with late closers having too much ground to make up. The prominent runners like King Jon Oliver and Oh My Johnny struggle to close the gap despite their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If King Jon Oliver and Oh My Johnny press Goodwin from the start
scenarios.body: The sustained pace stretches the field and favors the proven stayers with tactical speed. Libre De Choeur and Goshhowposh benefit from the strong gallop as hold-up horses with stamina reserves.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Mid-Race Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with no clear rhythm established
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with multiple horses still in contention at the last hurdle, favoring those with the best turn of foot. Magical King and Getaway Theatre emerge from the pack with superior finishing speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Surge Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate but quickens significantly from three out
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses find their rhythm late while early prominent runners tire, creating opportunities for patient rides. Sunray Shadow and Individualiste benefit from being held up as the race develops into a sprint finish.
